basics.name: Nur Hossain Raton
basics.label: Software Engineer at OpenRefactory, Inc.
basics.summary: Software Engineer with experience building production-grade full-stack applications and security-focused backend systems. Worked on CVE root cause analysis by analyzing commit histories and applying LLM-based code understanding techniques. Familiar with system design concepts, RESTful APIs, and database design using Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.

work.name: OpenRefactory, Inc.
highlights: Led the implementation of a core security feature—Root Cause Analysis—for identifying functions directly responsible for CVEs by analyzing commit histories across multiple sources.
Applied LLM-based code understanding to correlate commits, functions, and vulnerability severity, improving accuracy of package security assessment.
Contributed to multiple full-stack features for the Project Clean Beach product, working across frontend, backend, and database layers.
Worked with Next.js, Python, and PostgreSQL to develop production-grade security and full-stack features.

work.name: ACS Future School
highlights: Designed and implemented end-to-end features including threaded comments, notifications, ticketing systems, and admin dashboards using Next.js and PostgreSQL.
Designed scalable REST APIs and optimized PostgreSQL schemas to support growing user and admin workflows.
Collaborated with stakeholders to translate product requirements into production-ready features.
Worked with Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, and PostgreSQL.

education.institution: Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology

projects.name: MasterClass BD Academy
contributions: Built and deployed a full-stack production EdTech platform featuring course enrollment, user authentication, blog system, interactive quizzes, resource library, and an admin panel for managing users, content, and analytics.
Integrated an LLM-powered chatbot via API for learner support and course-related Q&A, demonstrating hands-on experience with prompt engineering and LLM integration in a production environment.
Designed scalable REST APIs and database schemas to support concurrent users across multiple features including quiz submissions, blog posts, and resource downloads.

projects.name: Cryptodiction
contributions: Implemented a time-series forecasting pipeline using BiLSTM, Performer architecture, and GARCH volatility modeling for Bitcoin price prediction.
Evaluated model performance on historical data and analyzed volatility trends.

Implemented global state management using Redux, improving UI responsiveness and consistency.
Designed RESTful APIs and MongoDB schemas to handle concurrent user activity.
